{{Quote|This is the Outer Rim. You have no rights here.|The woman defies the Third Sister|<ref name="Part I" />}}
A [[human]] '''woman''' lived in [[Anchorhead]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. [[Gender|She]] was present when members of the [[Inquisitorius]] arrived in Anchorhead searching for a [[Nari|Jedi]] who had eluded them in [[Mos Eisley]]. When she stood up to the intimidation of the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], the woman [[Dismemberment|lost]] her right [[Limb|hand]] as punishment.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We're not under the Empire's—|The woman's statement is cut short as the Third Sister cuts off her hand|<ref name="Part I" />}}
[[File:AnchorheadWomanLosesHand-OWKpI.png|thumb|left|300px|The woman lost her hand to Third Sister's lightsaber.]]
During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], this [[human]] [[Gender|female]] lived in [[Anchorhead]], a [[City|town]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Tatooine]]. She had pale skin with [[Color|red]] [[hair]] and hazel [[eye]]s.<ref name="Part I" />

In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref> three members of the [[Inquisitorius]] failed to apprehend a [[Jedi]] named [[Nari]] who was hiding in [[Mos Eisley]]. Some [[time]] later, two of the [[Inquisitor]]s known as the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] and [[Fifth Brother]] arrived in Anchorhead looking for the Jedi. The Third [[Sister (Inquisitorius)|Sister]] began threatening to [[Dismemberment|cut off]] the townsfolk's [[Limb|hands]] if they refused to cooperate. This woman spoke up, claiming the Empire had no authority in the Outer Rim. Before she had finished her protest, the Third Sister followed through on her threat, igniting her [[Reva's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and slicing off the woman's right hand.<ref name="Part I" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Thrilled to be part of @Starwars history in @obiwankenobi! Look for me Guest Starring in Episode One at @disneyplus.|Karen Constantine on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]]|<ref name="TwitterQuote">{{Twitter|KARECONSTANTINE|status/1530483198655836161|[[Karen Constantine]]|quote=Thrilled to be part of @Starwars history in @obiwankenobi! Look for me Guest Starring in Episode One at @disneyplus.|date=2022-05-28|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/3tbgv}}</ref>}}

The woman first appeared in "[[Part I]]" of the [[Disney+]] live action television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi Wan Kenobi'']], directed by [[Deborah Chow]]<ref name="Part I" /> and released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Episode 1 Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']]|date=2022-05-27|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref> She was portrayed by [[Karen Constantine]] and credited as "Local Anchorhead Woman".<ref name="Part I" /> Series writer [[Joby Harold]] came up with the woman getting her hand suddenly cut off by the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] as a way to depict the antagonist's impulsivity to accomplish her singular goals through action instead of just monologuing.<ref name="Vader terrifying">{{WebCite|url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2022/06/obi-wan-kenobi-explained|text=''Obi-Wan Kenobi:'' Darth Vader Was Originally Even More Terrifying|author=Breznican, Anthony|date=2022-06-03|work=[[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair (magazine)|''Vanity Fair'']]|archivedate=20220603154447}}</ref>
